ladder.name: observed_order
ladder.wording: The symptoms of this unit were observed in the recording in the order listed.

ladder.name: consistent_with_declared_dependency
ladder.wording: The order fits a declared dependency edge and window, which is consistent with propagation along the declared edge.

ladder.name: compatible_with_mechanism
ladder.wording: The evidence is compatible with this mechanism; it is supported by the listed evidence.

ladder.name: alternatives_excluded_within_coverage
ladder.wording: The recorded evidence favours this mechanism over the listed alternatives.

ladder.name: difference_evidence
ladder.wording: The evidence indicates this mechanism, supported by a contrast between these recordings.

limitations: Tiers order candidates by how many of their predictions the evidence meets. They are not probabilities.
A prediction that the evidence does not meet stays open; the report cannot show that nothing happened on a topic.
Results on the synthetic corpus show that the software follows its definitions, not accuracy on real robots.
Real-recording validation and decoder licensing clearance are still outstanding.
The catalogue entries are proposals until a named reviewer has signed each one off; the review status of every entry is shown.
The level printed next to a hypothesis is the highest level whose evidence is fully present. It is not a measure of how likely the mechanism is.
problems: The report was made with a dependency file that was not supplied here, so declared neighbours are bound from the system model only.
rule: A set has a leader only if its first instance is supported, has a satisfied share of at least 1/2, exceeds every other instance that is not contradicted by at least 1/3, and its unit has no blocker. Otherwise the set is competing, or unresolved when nothing is supported.

always_present.sentence: A common or independent source of these symptoms is not excluded by the declared dependencies or the observations.
An artifact of observation or timing is not excluded: recorder receipt time is not occurrence time, and the recording may be incomplete.
The available evidence does not separate the candidate mechanisms, and it is not enough to choose among them.
